services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Fishing was fantastic once again this week in Traverse City, with anglers enjoying consistent action on lake trout, salmon, and a few steelhead throughout West Grand Traverse Bay. Summer fishing continues to provide excellent opportunities for anglers of all experience levels. One thing that made this week unique was the wildfire smoke drifting into Northern Michigan from Canada, creating a noticeable haze over the bay. While visibility across the water was reduced, the fish didn’t seem to mind, and the bite remained outstanding.
